description: State Ministry of Promoting the Production & Regulating the Supply of Organic Fertilizer and Paddy etc. - The Control of Pesticides (Pesticide Technical and Advisory Committee) Rules No. 1 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made by the Pesticide Technical and Advisory Committee under the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980. It establishes regulatory procedures for committee meetings, quorum requirements, voting procedures, and disclosure rules. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks created under an existing Act of Parliament.
